digest.component_or_area: git-fetch test suite / stall remote fixture
propositions: The full-suite scheduler load causes intermittent false stall classification of valid dribbling git-fetch transfers due to delayed fixture wake-ups reducing actual throughput below promised rate.

Applying a shared 2-second low-speed window to both zero-byte stall controls and above-floor negative controls makes the latter non-deterministic under scheduler delays, despite libcurl correctly aborting at the configured boundary.
The cumulative bytes-owed catch-up calculation alone is insufficient; scheduler gaps can exceed the window before catch-up takes effect.

The stable remedy separates zero-byte stall tests (fast 2-second window) from one production-window dribble integration test (10-second window with sufficient transfer length) and replaces redundant timing trials with deterministic unit tests of pacing math.
